implementation_summary: proposal.ts: fillProposal(template, view, inputs, company, labels, options?) reads the Markdown template's structure first (headings, -/*/+ and numbered lists, > notes, paragraphs; a leading # heading becomes the title), then fills placeholders in one pass so values are never searched again and stay plain text in AuditDoc blocks for the renderers to escape. When findings_summary, scope, not_included or timeline stand alone on a line they become blocks (group-count list plus top-5 findings table; Page/Work/Reason table; list; phase label plus item list per Improvement Roadmap phase); inline they become one line. Scope uses the edited view: a page's own recommendation edit first, then its own action, then its Sample Page's; the reason is shown only when the page's action was not edited. Removed pages are already gone from the view. An empty price or payment terms shows a per-language 'to fill in' marker. Unknown placeholders stay as written and are returned in unknownPlaceholders. PROPOSAL_PLACEHOLDERS documents every placeholder. The templates and opt-out text are English and Tamil defaults kept as TS constants. settings.ts: auditSettingsDefaults(), defaultProposalTemplate(lang), StoredAuditSettings (a left-out field uses the default), emptyAuditSettings(), resolveAuditSettings(stored, pagespeedKeySaved), and applySettingsUpdate(current, update), which refuses wrong types, unknown keys, empty or over-long text, control characters and an rewriteOverlapWords that is not a whole number from 1 to 100, with per-field errors, all-or-nothing and without changing its input. Null puts the template or a language's opt-out text back to the default. pagespeedKey is returned untouched beside the settings and never stored, and error messages never repeat it.

English opt-out wording and the default template text need product and legal review (REQ-019 notes that opt-out wording alone does not make outreach lawful).
fillProposal has an extra optional sixth argument { language, now } beyond the planned five-argument signature; the language defaults to the labels table's language.
AuditSettingsDefaults.proposalTemplate is one string, set to English; the Tamil default is only reachable through defaultProposalTemplate('ta').
Caps not given by the task: template 20000 characters, opt-out 2000, company name/phone/email/website 300 each, address 1000, terms 10000, rewriteOverlapWords up to 100, PageSpeed key up to 512.
Inline Markdown in a template (bold, links) is shown as literal text because all block text is escaped by the renderers.
When the tool user edits a page's redesign or repair choice, its original reason is dropped from the scope table.
